guidelines.detail: refines FID-01 (The description explicitly includes taking leave, while the corresponding activity is absent from the generated model. This refines the general instruction to model every distinct activity stated in the description by identifying a preparation–performance–review pattern. The generated selection task is a different task type from the reference selection activity, so that difference is not treated a)

same as LRN-004 (The description supports the stated actions and outcomes, while the matched labels alter or omit some of those distinctions. LRN-004 already gives essentially the same label-faithfulness guidance.)

same as LRN-042 (The description says the process includes taking leave and later considering an extension; the reference has a distinct activity for the period of leave, which is missing from the generated model. This is the same guidance as learned rule LRN-042.)

same as LRN-004 (The description explicitly says to let the parent select and to gather information from companies, while the records show a corresponding selection task and a label that changes gathering information into receiving a confirmation. The guideline is already covered by learned rule LRN-004. Several other reference activities are not stated in the description, so their absence does not support adding )

refines ACT-07 (The description explicitly places the decision at the end of the period, and the reference has a flow from the period activity to that decision and separate outcomes. The generated model’s missing flow shows this timing and routing were not represented. ACT-07 covers using a gateway for a decision; this guideline adds when to place it and how to route its outcomes.)

same as LRN-042 (The description explicitly includes taking the leave, while the record reports that this activity has no counterpart. Modeling the stated carrying-out period addresses that omission, and the learned guideline LRN-042 already says essentially the same thing.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes preparation for an activity from a period of carrying it out and a later review or decision about continuing it.: Model the carrying-out period as a distinct activity in the process flow between the preparation and the later review or decision; do not omit it merely because the description gives few operational details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes preparation for an activity from a period of carrying it out and a later review or decision about continuing it.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names an activity or milestone for which a BPMN task is being labeled: Label the task to preserve the action and purpose stated in the description; do not substitute a related but different action or milestone.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity, milestone, recipient, object, or outcome that distinguishes it from related work

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a participant decides at the end of a stated period whether to continue an activity: Model the decision after that period and use an exclusive gateway to route either to continuation work or to completion.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a participant decides at the end of a stated period whether to continue an activity
